play-doom.json:

  "intent": "play doom",

    "boot",
    "allocator",
    "pci",
    "terminal",
    "scoped",

    "[INPUT] keyboard ready",

  ],

  "decisions": []
}

host-repo.json:
{
  "intent": "host this repo",
  "matched_rule": "host-repo",
  "requires": [
    "boot",
    "allocator",
    "pci",
    "terminal",
    "scoped",
    "ipv4",
    "tcp",
    "http-server",
    "dhcp-client",
    "module-asset",
    "e1000"
  ],
  "excludes": [
    "fs",
    "sched",
    "ipc"
  ],
  "assets": [
    "repo.cpio"
  ],
  "markers": [
    "[NET] dhcp bound",
    "[HTTP] repo mounted",
    "[HTTP] listening on :80"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "network: assuming e1000 \u2014 the QEMU PC's NIC; state a target to choose from its devices instead",
    "input: assuming serial console; pass --input keyboard for a framebuffer image"
  ],
  "target": "",
  "decisions": []
}
